subject: Asteria MAP: evaluation guardrails & decision gates
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@asteria.com>; Procurement <procurement@asteria.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Asteria MAP: evaluation guardrails & decision gates

Hi Sara / Asteria team,

Thanks again for carving time yesterday. As discussed, I attached a first-pass mutual action plan that focuses on three things you asked for: measurable success criteria, clear exit gates, and a compact set of acceptance tests we can run during the evaluation window.

Key asks for you this week: please flag any criteria that are deal blockers for Asteria (security, retention policies, or latency guarantees) and confirm the internal approvers for sign-off. I suggest a two-week smoke phase followed by a four-week functional evaluation, but we can compress if you have tightened deadlines.

Attachment: Asteria_MAP-draft.xlsx (MAP milestones, owners, timelines)

High level MAP summary:
- Goal: 80% intent classification accuracy on sampled production traffic + 95th pct latency < 250ms for 99% of inference calls (within your region).
- Exit gate (smoke): successful model safety checks, no P0s in critical flows, and signed data handling appendix.
- Acceptance tests: blackbox smoke with 200 synthetic cases, 3 production-sampled test batches, replay test for data residency.

Marissa / Karthik: adding you on the thread to capture ops/playbook items we promised Sara.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0123

From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@asteria.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@asteria.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 11:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Asteria MAP: evaluation guardrails & decision gates

Jordan — thanks for the summary and the file. A few clarifying points from our side:

1) Data residency: we need the eval to be isolated to our US region and logs retained for 30 days only; no external backups. Is that spelled out in the data handling appendix?
2) Latency target: 250ms p95 is doable, but our legal team will want a hard-stop clause if any P0 (data exposure) is found.
3) Timeline: leadership wants a go/no-go decision by March 10th; can we compress the functional window to 3 weeks if smoke goes clean?

Also looping procurement so they can get a skeleton SOW in motion. Attaching a short procurement checklist they requested.

—Sara
Sara Patel
Head of Product, Asteria Systems
sara.patel@asteria.com

Attachment: Asteria_procurement-checklist.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>; Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Sara Patel <sara.patel@asteria.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Asteria MAP: evaluation guardrails & decision gates

Jordan / Karthik — I reviewed the draft and made a few concrete changes (attached):
- Split acceptance tests into three tiers: smoke (safety + perf), functional (accuracy/edge cases), and compliance (SOC2 evidence + audit checklist).
- Added a step for a replay test using a redacted sample; owner: Asteria / redwood SRE.
- Clarified rollback triggers: any P0 safety incident triggers immediate suspend and postmortem; two P1s within 48 hours triggers escalation to leadership.

I prioritized short, executable test definitions rather than long narratives so Asteria's engineers can run them quickly.

Attachment: Asteria_MAP-v1.xlsx

Marissa Cole
Manager, Customer Success Engineering
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@asteria.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Asteria MAP: evaluation guardrails & decision gates

Sara — quick replies to your bullets:

1) Residency: yes — we will spin a dedicated us-west cluster and enforce a 30-day log TTL. I'll own the runbook for proof (SRE checklist + audit log export).
2) Legal clause: working with our contracts team; we can add a hard-stop for data exposure incidents and include an agreed remediation SLA in the SOW.
3) Timeline: if smoke completes by Feb 26th (no P0s and safety checklist passed), we can run a compressed 3-week functional window and target your March 10th decision. That will shift some gated items to parallel tracks — I've flagged those in the MAP under 'parallelizable tasks'.

Also attaching a brief acceptance-tests doc (PDF) with exact commands and expected outputs for Asteria's QA team to run.

Karthik Iyer
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

Attachment: Asteria_acceptance-tests.pdf

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@asteria.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 17:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Asteria MAP: evaluation guardrails & decision gates — final MAP for sign-off

Hi all — attaching the updated MAP with approvals column filled and a condensed acceptance test runbook at the top for quick reference. Summary of changes since the draft: 

- Finalized success criteria:
  • Accuracy: >= 80% macro-averaged F1 on the agreed testset (sampling instructions in doc).
  • Performance: p95 latency < 250ms for 99% of calls during business-hours load profile.
  • Safety: zero data-exfiltration incidents; any safety regression is a P0.

- Exit gates (must all be green to move to functional): smoke pass, signed data appendix, SRE runbook validated by Asteria.
- Acceptance tests: enumerated commands, expected output snippets, and pass/fail criteria.
- Ownership & approvers: listed (Asteria product, Asteria procurement, Redwood CS, Redwood SRE).

Next step: Sara / Procurement — please confirm sign-off on the MAP and we will generate an SOW and DocuSign package early next week. If you want the compressed timeline (3-week functional), confirm by EOD Monday so we can lock resource planning.

Thanks — ready to move on your cue.

Lauren Bishop
Director, Customer Success Operations, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai

Attachment: Asteria_MAP-final-for-signoff.xlsx
